Pod detail: Last State Terminated Reason Error Exit Code 143 (SIGTERM from kubelet, NOT 137/OOMKilled) with image already pulled and ServiceAccount adservice present. Mechanism event: 'Liveness probe failed: timeout: failed to connect service 172.20.2.186:9555 within 1s: context deadline exceeded' -> 'Container server failed liveness probe, will be restarted' -> 'Back-off restarting failed container'. Config confirmation: adservice deployment sets livenessProbe initialDelaySeconds 1, periodSeconds 1, timeoutSeconds 1, failureThreshold 1 on grpc port 9555 — the probe address/port/protocol are correct (9555 = containerPort = PORT), so the failure is the over-aggressive timing: the slow-starting JVM is SIGTERM-killed 1s after start before binding the gRPC port, producing a restart loop.
